visual_brief.subject: Independent answers, verified business information and sponsored agent conversations require visible separation
verified_context: OpenAI launched Business Hub in beta for claimed profiles, product feeds and aggregated discovery analytics.
Eligible U.S. businesses can launch clearly separate Business Agent conversations and sponsor those agents as ad destinations.
The announcement does not independently establish ranking neutrality, privacy-threshold effectiveness or business outcomes.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Three commercial information relationships occupy adjacent rooms with clear thresholds rather than blending together.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: Neutral charcoal, verified sage and sponsored terracotta rooms sit side by side behind distinct architectural openings.

candidate_notes.A: Constitution-compliant, but shopping-bag and speech-bubble forms verge on iconography and merge the neutral and commercial paths.
candidate_notes.B: Selected. Three unmistakably separate rooms communicate independent, verified and sponsored contexts without labels or interface elements.
candidate_notes.C: Rejected at the constitutional gate because the profile medallion, key and speech bubbles form an icon composition.

crop_review.article_desktop: The complete metaphor and separation boundaries remain visible in the wide 1600×900 hero.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered cover crop retains the dominant chamber, gate or transformation and its terracotta signal.
crop_review.thumbnail: The physical silhouette remains distinct at 320px without relying on fine texture.

golden_reference_comparison: The selected candidate matches the golden references in warm paper field, restrained charcoal/teal mass, sparse terracotta signal, tactile materiality and confident negative space while keeping a story-specific silhouette.
